title: Synthetic Data Generation for Learning Analytics
summary: A bachelor thesis project that evaluates six synthetic data generation methods (Synthpop, DataSynthesizer, and four SDV methods) on five educational datasets using resemblance, utility, and privacy metrics. The SDV package is run directly via sdv.single_table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CopulaGAN, TVAE, CTGAN) and sdv.evaluation.single_table's quality/diagnostic functions to generate and assess synthetic learning-analytics data.
evidence: scripts/src/generation/synthetic_data_vault.py:44-47 instantiates CopulaGANSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and fits/samples each
